Tips.SourceString:
开启：小地图以玩家为中心。
关闭：将小地图的中心点与作战地图的中心点对齐。
Tips.LocalizedString:
On: The minimap is centered on the player.

Off: The minimap is centered on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString:
旋转：超弦体转向时，小地图向相反方向旋转，使超弦体头像始终向上。
固定：超弦体转向时，超弦体头像向相应方向旋转，小地图不旋转。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Rotate: When the character turns, the minimap rotates in the opposite direction so that the character icon is always facing upwards.

Fixed: When the character turns, the character icon rotates in the corresponding direction. The minimap does not move.

Tips.SourceString: 小地图模块在界面中的大小。
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the size of the minimap.

Tips.SourceString: 小地图的内容在模块中的缩小/放大比例。
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the zoom of the minimap.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，其他玩家无法查看你的个人信息。
Tips.LocalizedString: On: Hides your profile from other players.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，好友将无法观战你的对局。
Tips.LocalizedString: Enabling this option prevents your friends from spectating your matches.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，自动拒绝所有玩家发送的好友申请。
Tips.LocalizedString: Enable to automatically reject all friend requests.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，收到好友申请时，会弹出提示浮窗。
Tips.LocalizedString: Receive friend requests via popup.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，在对局结束后，会弹出系统推荐好友的提示浮窗。
Tips.LocalizedString: Off: You won't receive any friend recommendation notifications.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，亲密度3级以上的好友上线时，会弹出提示浮窗。
Tips.LocalizedString: On: A pop-up appears when friends with intimacy level 3 or higher come online.

Tips.SourceString:
全部：接收所有玩家发送给你的组队邀请。
仅好友：仅接收好友发送给你的组队邀请。
私密：屏蔽所有玩家发送给你的组队邀请。
Tips.LocalizedString:
All: Receive team invites from all players.

Friends Only: Receive team invites from friends only.

Private: Block all team invites.

Tips.SourceString:
对局内文字聊天的屏蔽。

关闭：显示所有文字消息。
队伍和比赛：屏蔽所有队伍玩家发送的聊天信息。
比赛：仅屏蔽敌方队伍玩家发送的聊天信息。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Off: Shows all messages.

Team/Match: Blocks text messages from everyone in the game.

Match: Blocks text messages from the enemy team only.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，对局过程中隐藏其他玩家发送给你的私聊信息的显示。
Tips.LocalizedString: Enable to hide in-game private messages.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，将对游戏内信息进行隐私化处理。
Tips.LocalizedString: Enable to anonymize in-game information.

Tips.SourceString:
开启后，将自己的ID用“我”替换显示。
仅作用于自己的屏幕显示。
Tips.LocalizedString: Enable to hide your ID.

Tips.SourceString:
开启后，对局内玩家昵称以“超弦体昵称”替换显示；对局外玩家昵称以“引航者”替换显示（好友、组队房间、战队除外）。
仅作用于自己的屏幕显示。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Enable to replace in-game player IDs with character names.
Replace out-of game player nicknames with "Navigator" (except friends, team rooms, and Union).

Affects your screen display only.

Tips.SourceString: 语言选项
Tips.LocalizedString: Select the interface language.

Tips.SourceString:
选择游戏角色配音使用的语言。
（备注：目前休息室仅部分角色支持切换日语配音）
Tips.LocalizedString: Select the character voiceover language.

Tips.SourceString: 选择对局内的系统播报语音。
Tips.LocalizedString: Select the voice for system annoucements.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，休息室的对话会显示语音字幕。
Tips.LocalizedString: On: Displays dormitory subtitles.

Tips.SourceString:
开启：显示斜十字准星反馈。
关闭：不显示斜十字准星反馈。
Tips.LocalizedString: When enabled, your crosshair will provide feedback when you deal damage.

Tips.SourceString:
对敌人造成伤害时显示伤害数据。

关闭：不显示伤害数据。
叠加：连续显示最近造成的伤害数据。
浮动：每造成单次伤害，显示单个数据。
合并：同时显示叠加数据和浮动数据。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Display damage numbers when hitting enemies.

Off: Hides damage numbers.
Overlay: Continuously shows a cumulative total of recent damage dealt.
Float: Displays individual damage numbers for each hit.
Both: Displays both overlay and floating damage numbers.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，显示己方玩家的描边。
Tips.LocalizedString: Displays the outline of teammates.

Tips.SourceString: 选择敌方玩家的描边颜色。
Tips.LocalizedString: Changes the outline color of enemies.

Tips.SourceString: 选择触发战术道具的闪光弹时，屏幕特效的颜色。
Tips.LocalizedString: Choose the screen effect color for flashbangs.

Tips.SourceString:
开启：敌方玩家可以看见自己穿戴皮肤的特殊飘飞特效。
关闭：敌方玩家仅可以看到自己的基础飘飞特效。
Tips.LocalizedString:
On: Enemies will see the gliding effect of your equipped skin.

Off: Enemies will only see the basic gliding effect of your character.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，当战术道具栏位没有物品时，会自动拾取附近其他玩家被淘汰后掉落的战术道具。
Tips.LocalizedString: When you don't have a tactical item, you will automatically pick up tactical items dropped by nearby players when eliminated.

Name.SourceString: 被观战者芯片默认显示

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，在进行观战时，被观战者的芯片会默认显示。
Tips.LocalizedString: Displays spectator chips by default.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，在对局准备阶段和亲密度7级的好友靠近时，会触发亲密度特效。
Tips.LocalizedString: Off: You won't see any friendship effects in matches.

Tips.SourceString: 开启显示命中后的血条跳动特效
Tips.LocalizedString: Shakes the health bar when landing a hit.

Tips.SourceString:
设置自己佩戴的头套外观可见范围（对以下模式不生效：一般爆破/排位爆破/大头乱斗/炸弹派对）
全员：比赛中所有玩家都可见；
队伍：仅我方队伍玩家可见；
自己：仅自己可见
Tips.LocalizedString:
Set Headgear Appearance (Not effective in: Demolition, Ranked, Bobblehead Brawl, and Boom Fest)
All: Visible to all players.
Team: Visible only to team members.
Self: Visible only to yourself.

Tips.SourceString:
获得所选品质及以上的物品时，触发红点提示。
保存后将在下次登录游戏时生效。
Tips.LocalizedString: You will receive a red dot notification when you obtain an item of the selected quality or above. This setting will take effect the next time you log into the game after it is configured.

Tips.SourceString:
方案一：仅超弦体界面，点击具体物品后消除红点
方案二：仅超弦体界面，点击物品类型后消除红点
Tips.LocalizedString:
Superstring Agents Interface Only

Option 1: Red dots clear after clicking specific items.
Option 2: Red dots clear after clicking item categories.

Tips.SourceString:
方案1 ：外观佩戴【随机最爱】时，每场对局中的“最爱”外观保持为纯随机。
方案2 ：外观佩戴【随机最爱】时，相邻对局中尽量选择不同的“最爱”外观。
方案3 ：外观佩戴【随机最爱】时，每场对局中尽量选择不同的“最爱”外观。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Option 1: When selecting [Random Favorite], the favorite setting in each match is purely random.

Option 2: When selecting [Random Favorite], the game chooses a different favorite setting for each subsequent match.

Option 3: When selecting [Random Favorite], the game chooses a different favorite setting for every match.

Tips.SourceString: 关闭：可兼容高回报率的鼠标设备。
Tips.LocalizedString: Off: Improve compatibility with high polling rate mice.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后垂直方向反转
Tips.LocalizedString: On: Reverses vertical controls.

Tips.SourceString: 向前移动
Tips.LocalizedString: Move forward.

Tips.SourceString: 向后移动
Tips.LocalizedString: Move backward.

Tips.SourceString: 向左移动
Tips.LocalizedString: Move left.

Tips.SourceString: 向右移动
Tips.LocalizedString: Move right.

Tips.SourceString: 以疾跑的速度移动，同时也发出更大的声音
Tips.LocalizedString: Increases movement speed, but also generates more noise.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，向前移动时自动开始疾跑
Tips.LocalizedString: Enable to automatically sprint when moving forward.

Tips.SourceString:
长按：“自动疾跑”关闭时按住疾跑、松开行走，开启时反之。
切换:人物先以"自动疾跑"所设置的状态移动，在移动过程中每按下一次疾跑键，人物就在行走与疾跑间切换；停止移动后仍然记录所切换的状态。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Hold: When Auto Sprint is off, hold Sprint to run and release to walk. When it's on, the controls are reversed.
Toggle: Moves follow the Auto Sprint settings. Press Sprint to switch between walking and running while moving. After stopping, it retains the last switched state.

Tips.SourceString: 跳跃或二段跳
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the key for jump and double-jump.

Tips.SourceString:
角色在地面时：使角色进入侧身状态
角色在空中时：使角色进入飘飞状态
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the key for side stepping on the ground and gliding when airborne.

Tips.SourceString: 将侧身设置为长按模式或切换模式
Tips.LocalizedString: Set sidestep to hold or toggle.

Tips.SourceString: 将飘飞设置为长按模式或切换模式
Tips.LocalizedString: Set glide to hold or toggle.

Tips.SourceString: 贴墙后可在墙面上自由移动
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the key for wall-sticking.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，人物在贴墙向上移动至墙面顶部时会自动跳跃
Tips.LocalizedString: When moving up while wall-sticking, automatically jump up the wall.

Tips.SourceString: 调整贴墙上墙时自动跳跃的延迟时间
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the auto-jump delay when wall-sticking.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，人物在飘飞移动并触碰到可弦化墙面时会自动贴墙
Tips.LocalizedString: When touching a valid wall while gliding, automatically wall-stick.

Name.SourceString: 飘飞自动贴墙触发延迟

Tips.SourceString: 调整飘飞顶墙时自动贴墙的延迟时间
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the wall-stick delay when glide wall-sticking.

Tips.SourceString: 安装炸弹、拾取战术道具、开门
Tips.LocalizedString: Used to plant bombs, pick up tactical items, and open doors.

Tips.SourceString: 在游戏内呼出战术轮盘
Tips.LocalizedString: Hold to open the communication wheel.

Tips.SourceString: 在游戏内呼出表情轮盘
Tips.LocalizedString: Hold to open the emote wheel.

Tips.SourceString: 在游戏内丢弃炸弹
Tips.LocalizedString: Drops the bomb.

Tips.SourceString: 在游戏内使用喷漆
Tips.LocalizedString: Uses spray.

Tips.SourceString: 设置极限刀战模式中的格挡键位
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the Block key in Sword Clash.

Tips.SourceString: 使用当前装备的武器开火或攻击
Tips.LocalizedString: Fires or attacks with the currently equipped weapon.

Tips.SourceString: 肩射和开镜以外的特殊攻击动作
Tips.LocalizedString: Special attacks other than shoulder fire and ADS.

Tips.SourceString: 指定同时用于肩射和开镜的按键，长按肩射、切换开镜
Tips.LocalizedString: Designates a key for both shoulder fire and ADS. Press and hold the shoulder fire button to switch to ADS.

Tips.SourceString: 指定仅用于肩射的按键。使人物快速抬起武器，从而进行较为准确的射击
Tips.LocalizedString: Quickly raises your weapon for more accurate shots.

Tips.SourceString: 选择仅用于肩射的按键触发肩射的方式
Tips.LocalizedString: Select how shoulder fire is triggered by the designated key.

Tips.SourceString: 指定仅用于开镜的按键。使人物以瞄准镜瞄准，从而进行更为精准的射击
Tips.LocalizedString: Aim down sight for more accurate shots.

Tips.SourceString: 选择仅用于开镜的按键触发开镜的方式
Tips.LocalizedString: Select how ADS is triggered by the designated key.

Name.SourceString: 开火模式/开镜倍率切换

Tips.SourceString:
主武器瞄准镜倍率切换或开火模式选择
瞄准镜倍率切换：仅部分角色可用 
开火模式选择：仅星绘、信、千代
Tips.LocalizedString:
Switch the primary weapon scope magnification or fire mode.
Scope magnification: Available for select Superstring Agents.
Fire mode: Celestia, Nobunaga, Chiyo.

Tips.SourceString: 使人物为当前装备的枪械更换弹匣或装填弹药
Tips.LocalizedString: Reloads the currently equipped firearm.

Tips.SourceString: 装备主武器
Tips.LocalizedString: Equips the primary weapon.

Tips.SourceString: 装备副武器
Tips.LocalizedString: Equips the secondary weapon.

Tips.SourceString: 装备近战武器
Tips.LocalizedString: Equip Melee Weapon

Tips.SourceString: 装备战术道具一
Tips.LocalizedString: Equips tactical item 1.

Tips.SourceString: 装备战术道具二
Tips.LocalizedString: Equips tactical item 2.

Tips.SourceString: 切换至下一个武器
Tips.LocalizedString: Switches to the next weapon.

Tips.SourceString: 切换至上一个武器
Tips.LocalizedString: Switches to the previous weapon.

Tips.SourceString: 武器切换模式
Tips.LocalizedString: Set the weapon switch button.

Tips.SourceString: 释放主动技能
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the key for using active skills.

Tips.SourceString: 释放终极技能
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the key for using ultimate skills.

Tips.SourceString: 释放战术技能
Tips.LocalizedString: Assign the key for using tactical skills.

Tips.SourceString:
匹配/排位模式:按键在全体（同阵营）语音频道中发言

自定义房间:按键在全体（全部玩家）语音频道中发言
Tips.LocalizedString:
Challenge/Ranked: Press to speak in the team voice channel.
Custom Room: Press to speak in the all-player voice channel.

Tips.SourceString:
匹配/排位模式:按键在组队（小队成员）语音频道中发言

自定义房间:按键在组队（同阵营）语音频道中发言
Tips.LocalizedString:
Challenge/Ranked: Press to speak in the squad voice channel.
Custom Room: Press to speak in the team voice channel.

Tips.SourceString: 呼出标点轮盘
Tips.LocalizedString: Opens the ping wheel.

Tips.SourceString: 发出危险信号
Tips.LocalizedString: Sends a danger signal.

Tips.SourceString: 发出注意这里
Tips.LocalizedString: Sends an alert signal.

Tips.SourceString: 发出需要支援
Tips.LocalizedString: Sends an assist signal.

Tips.SourceString: 发出进攻这里
Tips.LocalizedString: Sends an attack signal.

Tips.SourceString: 打开局内成长升级界面
Tips.LocalizedString: Opens the String Energy Network interface.

Tips.SourceString: 单击打开大地图
Tips.LocalizedString: Press to open the map.

Tips.SourceString: 按住打开大地图
Tips.LocalizedString: Press and hold to open the map.

Tips.SourceString: 打开计分板
Tips.LocalizedString: Opens the scoreboard.

Tips.SourceString: 查看角色技能说明
Tips.LocalizedString: Opens the character skill description panel.

Tips.SourceString: 单击后显示/隐藏鼠标，仅在对战报告等特殊面板显示时生效
Tips.LocalizedString: Shows/hides the mouse in a match. Only takes effect on special interfaces such as the match report panel.

Tips.SourceString: 单击后显示/隐藏对局内UI
Tips.LocalizedString: Shows/hides the match report panel.

Tips.SourceString: 单击后暂时显示/隐藏对战报告面板，持续到被击败或下个对局准备阶段
Tips.LocalizedString: Click to temporarily show/hide the battle report panel until defeated or the next preparation phase.

Name.SourceString: 显示/隐藏被观战者芯片

Tips.SourceString: 单击后暂时显示/隐藏被观战者的芯片展示
Tips.LocalizedString: Press to toggle the spectator chip display.

Tips.SourceString: 点击后同意投降
Tips.LocalizedString: Click to Surrender

Tips.SourceString: 点击后拒绝投降
Tips.LocalizedString: Click to Refuse Surrender

Tips.SourceString: 打开更换角色界面
Tips.LocalizedString: Opens the character selection panel.

Tips.SourceString: 观战下一名角色
Tips.LocalizedString: Spectates the next character.

Tips.SourceString: 观战上一名角色
Tips.LocalizedString: Spectates the previous character.

Tips.SourceString: OB观战与录像回放中自由视角与指定角色视角切换
Tips.LocalizedString: Toggles between Free Camera and Fixed Player View in Spectator and Replay Mode.

Tips.SourceString: OB观战与录像回放中完全同步视角与环绕视角切换
Tips.LocalizedString: Toggle between Synced and Free Camera in Spectator and Replay Mode.

Tips.SourceString: OB观战与录像回放中开启/关闭玩家头顶详细信息
Tips.LocalizedString: Displays player overhead info in Spectator and Replay Mode.

Tips.SourceString: 切换以设置建造者的武器的可视性
Tips.LocalizedString: Toggle creator's weapon visibility in Settings.

Tips.SourceString: 打开/关闭创造者模式背包
Tips.LocalizedString: Switch on/off creator mode inventory.

Tips.SourceString: 在地图工坊模式中，快速试运行玩法的快捷键
Tips.LocalizedString: Shortcut key for Quick Test Run mode in Map Workshop.

Tips.SourceString: 可以在创造者/角色间来回切换
Tips.LocalizedString: Switch between Creator and Character

Tips.SourceString: 按下以截取预览图
Tips.LocalizedString: Press to Capture Map Preview

Tips.SourceString: 灵敏度越高，视角转动速度越快
Tips.LocalizedString: Higher sensitivity means faster camera rotation.

Tips.SourceString: 视角在垂直方向上的移动量相对于水平方向的倍率
Tips.LocalizedString: Adjust how vertical movement compares to horizontal movement.

Tips.SourceString: 肩射时的鼠标灵敏度倍率
Tips.LocalizedString: Multiplier for mouse sensitivity when shoulder firing.

Tips.SourceString: 1.25倍瞄准镜开镜时的灵敏度
Tips.LocalizedString: Sensitivity for 1.25x scope when aiming.

Tips.SourceString: 1.5倍瞄准镜开镜时的灵敏度
Tips.LocalizedString: Sensitivity for 1.5x scope when aiming.

Tips.SourceString: 2.5倍瞄准镜开镜时的灵敏度
Tips.LocalizedString: Sensitivity for 2.5x scope when aiming.

Tips.SourceString: 4倍瞄准镜开镜时的灵敏度
Tips.LocalizedString: Sensitivity for 4x scope when aiming.

Tips.SourceString: 选择显示模式
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the display mode.

Tips.SourceString: 选择应用的显示器设备
Tips.LocalizedString: Choose the display device to use.

Tips.SourceString:
更改游戏所有3D场景的渲染清晰度，不影响各2D界面的分辨率
如果在游戏中有卡顿、掉帧的情况，而图像质量也已全部设置为最低，可尝试降低此项数值
Tips.LocalizedString:
Determines the rendering quality of 3D scenes. Does not affect the resolution of 2D interfaces. 

If you experience freezes or frame drops with the lowest quality settings, try lowering this value.

Tips.SourceString: 按照渲染比例设置控制分辨率的缩放
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines resolution scaling according to the render ratio.

Tips.SourceString:
基于显示器：游戏内最大帧率不会超过显示器的刷新率和硬件配置所支持的最大帧率
自定义：游戏内最大帧率不会超过下方“最大帧率”设置项设置的帧率
Tips.LocalizedString:
Monitor-Based: The max frame rate will not exceed the value supported by your system.
Custom: The max frame rate will not exceed the defined value.

Tips.SourceString: 自定义游戏内最大帧率
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the max in-game frame rate.

Tips.SourceString: 改善画面撕裂
Tips.LocalizedString: Reduces screen tearing.

Tips.SourceString: 开启后，将使用高清UI资源，重启游戏后生效
Tips.LocalizedString: Uses high-definition UI resources. Takes effect when restarting the game.

Tips.SourceString:
调整友方特效LOD（细节层次），降低非关键特效质量，保证对战帧数稳定。（友方不包括自己）

*仅在PVE以及晶源感染模式生效
Tips.LocalizedString:
Adjusts ally effect LOD (Level of Detail) to lower non-essential effect quality and stabilize frame rate. (Excludes self)

*Effective in PVE and Outbreak mode only.

Tips.SourceString:
调整敌方特效LOD（细节层次），降低非关键特效质量，保证对战帧数稳定。

*仅在PVE以及晶源感染模式生效
Tips.LocalizedString:
Adjusts enemy effect LOD (Level of Detail) to lower non-essential effect quality and stabilize frame rate.

*Effective in PVE and Outbreak mode only.

Tips.SourceString: 调整整体图像质量
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines overall graphics quality.

Tips.SourceString: 调整渲染模式，前向渲染更加节省性能，延迟渲染表现更好
Tips.LocalizedString: Forward rendering is more performance-efficient, while deferred rendering offers better visual quality.

Tips.SourceString: 调整纹理质量，更高的贴图质量要求更多的显存
Tips.LocalizedString: Higher texture quality requires more VRAM.

Tips.SourceString: 调整材质质量，更高的材质质量要求更多的显存
Tips.LocalizedString: Higher material quality requires more VRAM.

Tips.SourceString: 调整纹理流的异步加载速度
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the async load speed of texture streaming.

Tips.SourceString: 控制表面细节的清晰度
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the clarity of surface textures.

Tips.SourceString: 控制动画的细节程度，低等级将会忽略某些细节
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the level of animation detail. Lower settings may discard some details.

Tips.SourceString: 模拟辉光效果
Tips.LocalizedString: Simulates glow effects.

Tips.SourceString: 模拟镜头里的光照散射，在画面上产生耀斑或彩色斑点
Tips.LocalizedString: Simulates light scattering in the lens, creating flares or colorful spots.

Tips.SourceString: 屏幕空间环境光遮蔽会在被几何物体遮挡的地方生成自然阴影
Tips.LocalizedString: Screen space ambient occlusion (SSAO) creates natural shadows in areas occluded by geometric objects.

Tips.SourceString: 调整游戏中的反射质量，较高的质量可以改善图像细节和平滑度
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the quality of reflections. Higher quality improves detail and smoothness.

Tips.SourceString: 调整游戏中粒子特效的精细程度
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the detail level of particle effects.

Tips.SourceString:
抗锯齿可以使图像边缘更平滑，消除锯齿线条和闪光

（XESS仅在DX12下可启用）
Tips.LocalizedString:
Anti-aliasing smooths image edges, reducing jagged lines and flicker.

(XESS is experimental and only available with DX12)

Tips.SourceString: 选择超分辨率模式的画面质量
Tips.LocalizedString: Select image quality for upscaling mode.

Tips.SourceString: 调整场景校色效果
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the color calibration.

Tips.SourceString: 模拟光线在穿过不同介质时的折射现象
Tips.LocalizedString: Simulates the refraction of light as it passes through different objects.

Tips.SourceString: 雾效
Tips.LocalizedString: Displays fog effects.

Tips.SourceString: 调整整体阴影质量
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines overall shadow quality.

Tips.SourceString: 调整模型细节表现
Tips.LocalizedString: Determines the level of model detail.

Tips.SourceString: Nvidia DLSS 帧生成技术，通过AI渲染获得额外的帧数，使画面更加流畅
Tips.LocalizedString: NVIDIA DLSS uses AI rendering to generate extra frames for smoother visuals.

Tips.SourceString: NVIDIA Reflex技术，开启后降低系统的延迟提升PC的响应速度。
Tips.LocalizedString: On: Enables NVIDIA Reflex to reduce system lag and boost PC responsiveness.

Tips.LocalizedString: Adjusts the volume of gunshots, footsteps, skills, and other in-game sound effects.

Name.SourceString: 角色语音/系统语音音量

Tips.SourceString: 调节游戏角色配音的音量
Tips.LocalizedString: Adjusts the character voiceover volume.

Tips.SourceString:
选择游戏内音效的空间音频效果。

如果遇到音频卡顿，可通过降低空间音频效果缓解。
如果遇到所有枪声、脚步声、敌方大招语音无声等异常情况，可能存在设备兼容性问题，尝试关闭空间音频效果解决，也可以尝试将音频输出配置修改为立体声或HRTF声效解决。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Use spatial audio effects for in-game sounds.

If you encounter audio lag, you may be able to resolve the issue by lowering the spatial audio.
If you cannot hear gunshots, footsteps, and/or enemy ultimate voice lines, there may be compatibility issues. Try disabling spatial audio or changing the audio output to stereo or HRTF.

Tips.SourceString: 开启房间及障碍物对声音的衍射效果，平滑过渡不同区域的音效表现
Tips.LocalizedString: Enables the diffraction of rooms and obstacles. Smoothens the transition of sound effects between different areas.

Tips.SourceString: 开启不同区域的混响效果，增加空间感
Tips.LocalizedString: On: Enables reverb for a more immersive experience.

Tips.SourceString:
选择游戏中脚步声、枪弹声、技能音效等其他游戏内声音呈现的方式，不同选择有不同的3D空间化效果。


跟随系统：根据音频设备及环境自动切换。

HRTF声效：通过耳机展现3D环绕声效，清晰地表现前后方的音效。启用HRTF时请关闭其他3D音效处理程序。

7.1环绕声：若设备或环境支持，将拓展声场并能听到各个方向的声音，带来更精准的声场定位。 若不支持或存在兼容性问题时，可能出现所有枪声、脚步声、敌方大招语音无声等异常情况，推荐切换回成立体声或HRTF声效。

杜比全景声：若设备或环境支持，可体验沉浸式的杜比全景声（Dolby Atmos），能够以萦绕于用户头顶上方及四周的震撼灵动音效，让你在游戏中拔得头筹，充分体验紧张刺激的氛围，仿佛穿越到游戏之中。
Tips.LocalizedString:
Choose how in-game sounds like footsteps, gunfire, and skill effects are presented, with each option offering different 3D spatial effects.

Follow System: Automatically switches based on audio equipment and environment.

HRTF: 3D surround sound via headphones with sound distinguished between the front and rear. Make sure to disable other 3D sound programs when using HRTF.

7.1 Surround Sound: If supported, expands the sound field to distinguish sounds from all directions for more precise sound localization. If not supported or there are compatibility issues, you may experience missing sounds like gunfire, footsteps, or enemy ultimate voice lines. It's recommended to switch back to stereo or HRTF.

Dolby Atmos: If your device or environment supports it, experience immersive Dolby Atmos sound that envelops you from above and around, placing you at the forefront of the game. Enjoy an intense and thrilling atmosphere as if you're transported into the game itself.
